caption:
You cannot widen your stop in the middle of market hours.

When a session turns against you, the impulse is to adjust limits. KaatDo keeps your rules locked during market hours. The six rules you set—max_daily_loss, profit_target, max_trades, kill_time, kill_days, and kill_dates—cannot be loosened while trading is live.

Every evaluation and broker action is recorded in a full audit log. You also get Telegram alerts, webhook calls, and email notifications.
